introHtml: Custom 3 oz lotion is the ideal size for travel giveaways, sample distributions, and employee wellness kits. At 3 ounces, these lotions meet TSA carry-on requirements, making them a practical choice for trade shows and corporate events. With a smooth, creamy formula, they provide a canvas for your logo or message via screen printing or label application. Whether you're promoting a spa event or rewarding staff, this compact size ensures your brand is always at hand.
